title: OpenTelemetry Tracing for Your FastAPI Application
summary: With OpenTelemetry, you can easily trace a single request across multiple services in a distributed system. In this post, I would like to share how you can set up OpenTelemetry tracing for your FastAPI application.
content:
With OpenTelemetry, you can easily trace a single request across multiple services in a distributed system.
In this post, I would like to share how you can set up OpenTelemetry tracing for your FastAPI application.
